title: Change PIN
summary: Changes the account PIN from a signed-in phone after a biometric check (ADR 0057). No old PIN is needed. The server notifies the recovery e-mail.

phase.description: confirmOwner: the biometric or passcode check. create and confirm: the PIN steps of signup-pin. saving: PUT /v1/me/pin runs.

error.description: bipe_error_network, bipe_error_rate_limited, a pinProblem string from pin_weak, or bipe_error_generic.

start.effect: Asks the device owner check with bipe_pin_change_biometric_reason. A failed or cancelled check closes the screen.

save.effect: PUT /v1/me/pin with the new PIN. On 204 shows bipe_pin_changed with the success haptic. With the lock on and one account on the phone, the lock PIN changes too (ADR 0086, ADR 0137).

notes: Setting the PIN on the server also unblocks it, sets the wrong-try count to 0 and cancels every waiting PIN reset (API contract).
The PIN steps and the weak-PIN rule are the same as signup-pin (registries/accounts.json, test-vectors/pins.json).

Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.setPIN (iOS), BipeAccountSession.changePin and BipeApiClient.setPin (Android); the owner check as in BipeDataExportRow (biometrics or the screen lock, else the app lock PIN).
